interpretation: Provider identity is currently the strongest non-causal selector signal.
Trace-only context terms are useful audit metadata but do not yet improve over provider-prior baselines.
This does not authorize a runtime arbiter because provider-prior success can encode dataset bias and does not prove guardrail-safe ownership.
The next step should be an architecture review of whether to add more labeled controls, define state-local contrast labels, or move back to broader curriculum integration.

recommended_next_step.description: Decide whether to expand protected-control labels, create state-local contrastive labels, or pause selector work and return to broader curriculum integration.
